description: T-SQL is the SQL language used by Microsoft SQL Server. It adds variables and control steps to table queries. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.
versionNote: Examples use SQL Server 2017 or later. Each query is a separate batch.
whatYouWillLearn: Ask for a message with T-SQL
Read a number safely with T-SQL
learningObjectives: Ask for a message with T-SQL
Choose which statement runs with T-SQL
Choose a missing-value fallback with T-SQL
